# Saving seed from the difficult corner

The plants beside the wall yielded fewer beans, but they survived the driest week. Saved their seeds separately. This is a small, uncontrolled selection experiment rather than proof of drought resistance. [[Garden notebook]] should keep that modest wording. Next year plant some beside the vigorous row and record the weather as well as the harvest.
